sara: Quick sync — Nyx-13B ingestion + catalog profile. Need final licensing verdict + perf profile before we flip the signal. TL;DR: legal flag + two perf regressions on long-context. @ken @mira please.

ken: Got it. what's the license tag in the repo? I scanned but saw ambiguous headers.

mira: I pushed preliminary perf run to /tmp/nyx13b-perf/ — 2x slower on 8k context vs mariner13b on same config. Notebook: https://gcs/redwood/nyx13b/runs/2026-03-17

oliver: License file in model tar is `LICENSE.md` but header mentions "CC-BY-NC-4.0" in model card. @legal-bot can you confirm

legal-bot: automated-scan: license=CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial). Flag=requires legal review for commercial hosting. See /legal/review-queue/nyx13b

sara: OK that's a gating item for hosted catalog. For Dedicated/private customers we can expose but need TOU note. @product-ops any update on messaging

product-ops: We'll add a "non-commercial" badge and copy for the model page. But legal signoff required before marketing. ETA from legal? @tj

tj: I can take the review. Will sync with legal infra and aim to close by EOD Friday. If NC stands, we'll add explicit license callout and checkbox in onboarding flow.

ken: On perf — mira can you paste the critical command you used? Want to reproduce locally.

mira: command:
```
./bench_infer --model nyx13b --ctx 8192 --batch 8 --device 4 --mode streaming
```
Results in ~320ms/token vs mariner13b ~160ms/token on same instance.

sara: Thanks. Two action items:
- tj -> legal review for NC clause (thread follow-up)
- mira/ken -> perf triage: kernel selection + quant profile check, try `quant=bitsandbytes-4bit` fallback

oliver: I'll add a short task in the model-card PR with the license flag and perf notes. tagging owners: @mira @ken

deploy-bot: canary-schedule set: nyx13b-staging @ 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC (blocked by legal-review)

mira: noted. I'll start an A/B with different quant profiles tomorrow and link results here.

sara: perfect. keep updates in this thread; I'll close the gate once legal and perf pass. :thumbsup:
